items.title: Golden Hour Wash
items.goal: The iconic bread-and-butter Titanic look: a continuous sunset wash with ember texture and Vintage-only golden-white sweeps.

items.title: Shimmer
items.goal: Elegant candlelight on moving water: fine traveling glints, a stable readable sign, and Jewelry as the golden lead.

items.title: Caustic Shimmer
items.goal: Calm refracted pool-light cells: broad lenses and cell walls shimmer without behaving like Moon River.

items.title: Lunar Current
items.goal: A bounded moonlit river with banks, shadow depth, and internal caustic lace—not a repeating full-rig field.

items.title: Bow Stern Tidal Push
items.goal: A coherent pressure wall travels bow-to-stern and returns as a broad recoil, readable from far across the playa.

items.title: Mirrored Broadside Call
items.goal: Mirrored wave walls call from the ship's centre to both ends, then answer inward in perfect bilateral symmetry.
